entities.name: St. Bartholomew's Day Massacre
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: Mass killing of Huguenots (French Protestants) beginning on 24 August 1572 in Paris and spreading across France. Between 5,000–30,000 Protestants were massacred, marking a turning point in the French Wars of Religion.
